Quick internal note and a question for the panel —

Quoted for context:
> "I can do one of the following:
> 1) Push to later today around 4:00 PM PT for a compressed 30–40 minute live session (would prefer later if the panel is available), or
> 2) Record a screen-share walkthrough of the coding task (I can narrate my thought process and show test runs) and submit the video within a few hours so the panel can review asynchronously."

My preference is to accept the recorded walkthrough today so we don't lose momentum. Practical asks if we go this route:
- Request a 20–30 minute screen-record that walks through the code and tests (no need for fancy editing).
- Ask Ethan to include a 1-paragraph decision summary (trade-offs, known gaps).
- Deadline: 7:00 PM PT so panel can watch and leave notes tonight.

If he can do a short live 20-minute check-in later (4–4:30 PM) great, but not required. If the recording arrives, we can run a 30-minute async debrief tomorrow and make a hiring decision timeline.

Vanessa / Jonas — ok to proceed on those terms?

—Marissa
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Thanks everyone —

Ethan, we can absolutely accept a recorded screen-share walkthrough. To make it easy for the panel to evaluate, please follow these minimal guidelines (attached as recording-guidelines.pdf):
- 20–30 minutes of screen-share showing your approach to the attached coding_task.pdf; run through tests locally if possible.
- Begin with a 1–2 minute summary of the design choices and trade-offs.
- Export as MP4 or similar and upload to Google Drive (you can share the link to this thread).
- Deadline: 7:00 PM PT tonight if possible. If you need an extra hour, let us know — we can be flexible to 8:00 PM PT.

Panel plan: Jonas and Marissa will review the recording this evening and add notes to the interview folder. We'll do a short async debrief tomorrow morning and confirm next steps. If the panel prefers a live follow-up, we'll offer a 30-minute slot next Tuesday (calendar invite placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=followup-tue).

Thanks again for the quick communication and for being flexible — appreciate it.

—Vanessa
